title: Cartography Workspace, Document, Large-Map Canvas, Viewport & Authority Contract
objective: Establish the creator-facing Multiversal Cartography Studio foundation: a versioned cartography workspace/document model, large-map canvas and viewport contract, stable map object/layer identities, and explicit presentation-vs-owner-projected-vs-binding-proposal authority dispositions without creating a second canonical World, Scene or map-asset ledger.

scope.purpose: Create the bounded MCS workspace/document/canvas/viewport foundation over existing map/resource and owner-domain contracts while preserving canonical World/Scene/spatial authority.
included: versioned cartography workspace and document identity
stable map object and layer identifiers
explicit presentation-only, owner-projected and binding-proposal dispositions
authority-boundary evidence for map editing and projection
scope.completion_gate: Representative cartography documents can be created and deterministically inspected through the MCS workspace/canvas/viewport seam with stable object/layer identity and explicit authority dispositions, without silently promoting pixels, vectors, labels or imported/generated metadata into canonical World/Scene/game truth.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after PCA-15 exact-tree publication. FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER is satisfied and MCS ordinary start gates PCA-03, PCA-04 and PCA-15 are completed; PCA-16 remains an MCS golden-proof dependency, not an ordinary start gate.

The DAG marks MCS, MCCS, MRCS and MSAS parallel-safe when their individual gates are satisfied. The owner-approved PCA planning surface identifies MCS-01 as the cross-program successor, so MCS-01 is the selected interstitial tie-breaker without starting the other lanes.
MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json defines MCS-01 as the first surviving MCS tranche and absorbs baseline MCS-01/MCS-02 scope.

MAI retains map-asset/package schemas and projection/grid/scale foundations; ISE/Scene/Tabletop retain live placement/camera/runtime interaction; SSA/World retain semantic spatial truth. MCS-01 must be a creator-facing authoring/presentation layer over those authorities.
Pixels, vectors, labels, imported metadata and generated output may not silently become canonical World, Scene, Combat, Exploration, Visibility, Settlement, Economy or other owner-domain truth.
MCS-03, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work are not authorized by this tranche.
next_action: Establish the smallest causal RED for MCS-01 through the public cartography workspace/document/canvas/viewport seam before writing production implementation.
